name: claude_plain
spec: group "Claude": spellings Claude, Anthropic. A text naming Claude or Anthropic hits "Claude" only.

name: anthropic_plain
spec: group "Claude": spellings Claude, Anthropic. A text naming Claude or Anthropic hits "Claude" only.

name: chatgpt_plain
spec: group "ChatGPT": spellings ChatGPT, OpenAI, GPT. A text that names only OpenAI / GPT / ChatGPT hits "ChatGPT" only — never "Claude".

name: openai_plain
spec: group "ChatGPT": spellings ChatGPT, OpenAI, GPT. A text that names only OpenAI / GPT / ChatGPT hits "ChatGPT" only — never "Claude".

name: gpt_plain
spec: group "ChatGPT": spellings ChatGPT, OpenAI, GPT. A text that names only OpenAI / GPT / ChatGPT hits "ChatGPT" only — never "Claude".

name: openai_api_example
spec: A text that names only OpenAI / GPT / ChatGPT (e.g. "experience with the OpenAI API") hits "ChatGPT" only — never "Claude".

name: gpt4_prompts
spec: A text that names only OpenAI / GPT / ChatGPT (e.g. "GPT-4 prompts") hits "ChatGPT" only — never "Claude".

name: chatgpt_plugins
spec: A text that names only OpenAI / GPT / ChatGPT (e.g. "ChatGPT plugins") hits "ChatGPT" only — never "Claude".

name: claude_code
spec: A text naming Claude or Anthropic hits "Claude" only ("Claude Code", "Anthropic's API").

name: anthropic_api
spec: A text naming Claude or Anthropic hits "Claude" only ("Claude Code", "Anthropic's API").

name: both_claude_gpt
spec: A text naming both hits both.

name: both_anthropic_openai
spec: A text naming both hits both.

name: both_mixed
spec: A text naming both hits both. "GPT-4" matches (a hyphen is a boundary); "Claude's" matches.

name: other_models_mistral_llm
spec: Other model names (Gemini, Llama, Mistral, "LLM", "generative AI") hit neither.

name: gpts_no_match

name: openais_no_match
spec: A word boundary is required: "OpenAIs" does not match.

name: claudeish_no_match
spec: A word boundary is required: "claudeish" does not match.

name: slash_block_x_claude
spec: "/" directly before a term blocks a match, e.g. "x/Claude" does not match Claude.

name: claude_possessive
spec: "Claude's" matches.

name: case_insensitive_mixed
spec: matched case-insensitively ... A text naming both hits both.

name: slash_block_claude_openai
spec: "/" directly before a term blocks a match ... the "/" sits before Anthropic — does NOT match Anthropic either, only OpenAI.

name: slash_openai_anthropic_ambiguous
spec: "OpenAI/Anthropic" matches both ... the "/" sits before Anthropic — does NOT match Anthropic either, only OpenAI.
why: The spec first says "OpenAI/Anthropic" matches both, then explicitly says the slash before Anthropic blocks Anthropic so only OpenAI matches; the expected value follows the more specific parenthetical.

name: slash_space_openai_anthropic
spec: "/" directly before a term blocks a match; here the slash is not directly before Anthropic, so both groups match.
